Professional Biography & Medical Training

Dr. Zainulabuddin Syed, MD, is an experienced, board-certified internal medicine physician in Downers Grove, Illinois, known for providing comprehensive, attentive care for adults and older adults. He graduated from Gandhi Medical College, Osmania University, completed his internal medicine residency training at Advocate Christ Medical Center, and is board certified by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM).

Dr. Syed has built his practice around thoughtful, patient-centered care. He speaks English, Urdu, Arabic, and Hindi, and he is deeply committed to creating a long-term partnership with each patient based on mutual respect, honesty, and open communication.

At Fairview Ogden Medical Group, Dr. Syed cares for patients with a wide range of medical needs, from preventative health and routine wellness physicals to complex internal medicine concerns like Type 2 diabetes, chronic hypertension, and cardiovascular risk reduction. Patients describe him as kind, knowledgeable, and exceptionally thorough.

“
My philosophy is built on treating the patient, not just the disease. Taking the extra time to listen carefully to each individual's lifestyle, family context, and personal concerns allows us to create treatment plans that truly work over the long term.
— Dr. Zainulabuddin Syed, MD

Clinical Focus Areas

Preventative Medicine & Wellness

Annual adult physicals, cholesterol screening, cancer risk reduction, and healthy lifestyle counseling.

Cardiovascular Health & Hypertension

Essential hypertension control, coronary artery disease management, and stroke prevention.

Diabetes & Metabolic Disorders

Targeted glycemic control for Type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome.

Acute Illness & Complex Diagnosis

Respiratory infections, sinusitis, UTIs, and unexplained internal medicine symptoms.
